title: T2 fix incomplete: mobile-help-playlist-link row missed — still a ~36px tap target in the same menu
evidence:
attribute("data-testid", "mobile-help-playlist-link"),
            attribute.href(copy.help_playlist_url),
            attribute("target", "_blank"),
            attribute("rel", "noopener noreferrer"),
            event.on_click(msg.UserToggledMobileMenu),
            class("text-amber font-headline text-sm py-2 block"),
detail: The approved T2 fix ("mobile menu rows + sign-out 44px") raises every sibling row to min-h-[44px], but this interactive 'See all guides →' row keeps py-2 (~36px) — same menu, same guideline, left behind.
recommended_fix: Add min-h-[44px] flex items-center to the playlist-link class at shell.gleam:469 (dropping the now-redundant block), matching view_mobile_help_link at line 483.

title: Conflicting display utilities: class list carries both block and flex on the help-guide rows
detail: Renders as flex only because Tailwind v3.4 emits .flex after .block in the stylesheet; the leftover block is dead, misleading, and depends on internal emission order rather than the class list.
recommended_fix: Remove block from the class string — flex items-center min-h-[44px] fully replaces it.

title: Near-identical private view_copy_button in two modules; the 44px fix had to be applied twice in lockstep
detail: The diff edits the same copy-button styling in two separate near-identical helpers; AGENTS.md DRY rule says extract helpers when logic repeats in 2+ places.
recommended_fix: Extract one shared copy-button component (e.g. components/copy_button.gleam) and use it from both vacancy_handoff and distribution_strip.

title: Terminal-roots test pins only the Rejected stepper; view_auto_closed's w-full root has no pin
detail: view_auto_closed's root is a separate class literal; if a later refactor drops its w-full, the auto-closed stepper regresses on mobile with no failing test despite the test's plural name.
recommended_fix: Extend the same test with an AutoClosed application asserting the identical 'flex flex-col items-end gap-2 w-full' string.
